title: Tier E reusable collector-loop adaptive pacing matrix
command: MAZEWALL_TIER_E_BENCHMARK_SCOPE=tier-e-poll-backoff MAZEWALL_TIER_E_BENCHMARK_WORKLOAD=syscall_dense MAZEWALL_TIER_E_FORKS=5 MAZEWALL_TIER_E_WARMUPS=3 MAZEWALL_TIER_E_BATCHES=10 MAZEWALL_TIER_E_ITERATIONS=100 bash ./scripts/run_tier_e_trustworthy_benchmark.sh build/tier-e-adaptive-poll-20260918
scope: rootful reusable collector-loop pacing comparison; dictionary transport, uprobe, full capture, terminal publication

arms.adaptive_1us_to_50us: 1 microsecond initial post-empty-drain park, doubled to a 50 microsecond cap and reset by any drained record

correctness.decoded_evidence_equivalence: all fixture-declared operations matched; no arm changed exact operation accounting

decision: Do not promote adaptive pacing to the default. It is correct and sharply reduces busy-poll iterations, but the five paired workload deltas differ by emission mode and have wide signs/ranges. This run also does not establish end-to-end observation-latency bounds, sustained-overload behavior, or long-session adaptive behavior. Keep continuous polling as the default and expose adaptive policy only to a future production integration after those measurements.
